what: Proposed monitor-side bullet overstates what streaming redaction guarantees
scenario_or_breakage: The current streaming redactor only replaces recognized full-line regex families and PEM markers; incomplete token fragments or partial PEM markers can still pass with exit 0, so documenting that partial PEM blocks or partial token shapes never appear creates a false operator-safety guarantee
suggested_fix: Limit the bullet to recognized PEM blocks and covered token patterns, and move incomplete or non-pattern fragments into the residual sensitive-content risk bullet

what: Proposed fail-closed wording overstates hidden leading-dot entry handling
scenario_or_breakage: The helper iterates "$source_dir"/*, so hidden entries such as .secret.ndjson or a hidden symlink are not visited and therefore do not trigger the documented leading-dot or symlink rejection, though they are also not published
suggested_fix: Revise the docs-only plan to say non-hidden enumerated entries are validated and hidden entries are ignored/not published, or explicitly expand the implementation and tests to enumerate and reject dotfiles
